title: [Cross-Tenant] Internal Dashboard – LA Reconciliation Search – Archived LA Not Distinguished From an Active One
description: AC-5 - Negative - [UNVERIFIED]: The reconciliation dashboard's Lesson Allocation lookup has no archive awareness - an archived LA is indistinguishable from an active one in the tool's output.
preconditions:
Ops/support staff has access to the Internal Dashboard LA reconciliation tool
Student A's Lesson Allocation for Course A is archived (Archived_At__c populated, via its order group being fully removed) - a correct, expected state per this epic's design
steps_actions:
1. "Staff searches the dashboard using Student A's Student (Contact) Id or the archived Lesson Allocation's Id"
2. "Staff reviews the row's status/flag"
steps_result:
1. "The tool resolves to Student A's Student Course and reports on the Lesson Allocation it finds"
2. "[UNVERIFIED] Record actual behavior: the row is shown as a normal, healthy Lesson Allocation entry with no indication it is archived (fail - staff cannot distinguish 'correctly archived' from 'actually missing/broken', defeating the tool's diagnostic purpose)"
steps_data:
1. "LA Archived_At__c = populated"
2. "No Archived_At__c field surfaced anywhere in getLessonAllocations's query or output columns"

title: [Cross-Tenant] Internal Dashboard – LA Reconciliation Search – Archived LA's Underlying Gap Could Be Masked as 'Found'
description: AC-5 - Negative - [UNVERIFIED]: If a genuinely broken sync coincides with an unrelated archived LA for the same student/course being returned by the unfiltered query, staff could be misled into believing a Lesson Allocation was found when it's actually an unrelated archived record.
preconditions:
Student B has a backend Student Package Order with no corresponding active Lesson Allocation (a genuine sync gap)
Student B separately has an unrelated, already-archived Lesson Allocation for a different, past enrollment under the same Student Course grouping
steps_actions:
1. "Ops staff searches the dashboard for Student B to diagnose a reported sync issue"
2. "Staff reviews the search result"
steps_result:
1. "Per the tool's purpose, it should clearly flag that no active Lesson Allocation exists for the current enrollment, distinct from the unrelated archived one"
2. "[UNVERIFIED] Record actual behavior: the unfiltered query returns the archived LA as if it were a valid match, potentially causing staff to close the investigation prematurely believing the sync is healthy (fail), or the tool already distinguishes this correctly some other way not yet identified (pass)"
steps_data:
1. "Backend SPO exists; only archived LA found"
2. "Actual result to be captured; getLessonAllocations has no Archived_At__c filter to exclude this row"
